msa-diff.answer: Harbor MSA v2 vs v1: Initial Term 24 months (was 12); auto-renewal added (v1 did not auto-renew); convenience termination 90 days (was 30); liability cap USD 250,000 / 12-month fees (was USD 50,000 / 6-month fees).

liability-cap.answer: Article 10.2.1 Cap on Damages: aggregate liability shall not exceed the fees paid or payable in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the first claim. No dollar floor. Tree path in the PageIndex demo: Article 10 → 10.2 → 10.2.1 → p.14. This is not the Harbor Robotics cap.
